name: Succubus☆Yuuna no Gohoushi Lesson♪
original_name: サキュバス☆ユーナのご奉仕レッスン♪
source:
Yuna is a cute but boyish succubus.
However since this is her first visit to the human world the sum of her sexual experience is zero.
To train and learn about sex, she chooses Masaya, the steadfast protagonist of this story.
